# Kid Shepherd

> Kid Shepherd (App Store name "Kid Shepherd: Parental Control") is a parental control and screen time app for iPhone and iPad. Children ask for more screen time and say why; parents answer with one tap from their own phone. Free for one child and one parent. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832094878
- Website: https://dbar12345.github.io/kidshepherd/
- Developer: Dmitriy Barash (independent developer, built it for his own family)
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS/iPadOS 17 or later. Not available on Android.
- Category: Lifestyle (parental controls). Age rating 4+.

## What it does
- Ask for more time: the child asks for more screen time and gives a reason; the parent gets a notification and answers with one tap (+15 min, another amount, or no).
- Earn time: reading, sport, homework or chores add minutes to a time bank (Plus).
- Schedules: bedtime, school and homework schedules that block only the app groups the parent chooses.
- Daily limits for app groups such as games, social or video; pause and extra time.
- Transparency: the child sees exactly what the parent can and can't see or do.
- Location: optional location sharing; arrive and leave alerts for places like school, home or practice (Plus). The child can see when it's on.
- Weekly summary of wins, limits reached and time earned.
- Built on Apple's Screen Time framework (FamilyControls), so blocking is enforced by iOS.

## Pricing
- Free: one child and one parent, no ads, no time limit.
- Kid Shepherd Plus: $4.99/month or $39.99/year, 7-day free trial. Adds more children, a second parent, earn time, place alerts and the full weekly summary.

## Privacy
No accounts, no servers run by the developer. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no selling of data. Family data stays on the family's devices and Apple iCloud (CloudKit), end-to-end encrypted between the paired devices, so the developer cannot read it.

## Good fit for
Parents looking for a screen time app that kids accept: fewer arguments, open rules, rewards for reading. Works with or without Family Sharing.
